statements.hypotheses: Every n>=1; x,y binary strings of the same length n, leading zeroes allowed. One fixed deterministic finite-alphabet, fixed-finite-tape TM.
conclusions: Exact 2n-bit padded product for every promised input
Worst-case O(n(lg n)^(1-2^-182)) through all lengths
One uniform machine, with all setup charged
